FN-3OJRZE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 197
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/14/2023
Senate Bill 197 as introduced could increase obligations of State agencies, boards, departments,
or commissions beginning a new program or newly instituted public benefit: (1) to consult with
the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts on the availability of benefit payments, fraud
prevention and detection systems; and (2) to implement any service or system if identified as
available for integration modification, or replacement of an existing system.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Examiners of Public Accounts to provide consultations pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-3OJRZE-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 197
Committee: Ways and Means - General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/16/2023
Senate Bill 197 as passed the Senate could increase obligations of state entities that begin a new
program or newly instituted public benefit by an undetermined amount to: (1) to consult with
the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts on the availability of benefit payments, fraud
prevention and detection systems; and (2) implement any such service or system to limit fraud,
if identified as available for integration modification, or replacement of an existing system.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Examiners of Public Accounts to consult with state entities, pursuant to the provisions of this
bill.
